key_insight: TOF3D enables large-scale 3D topology optimization on a consumer GPU by using displacement differences to suppress single-precision stiffness errors without added runtime.
engineering_relevance: The open-source Python code makes stress-constrained, manufacturing-robust, compliant-mechanism and porous-infill design accessible on a single 12 GB GPU.
method: Density-based topology optimization with a matrix-free stiffness operator.
Conjugate gradient solves preconditioned by geometric multigrid.
Element products formed from nodal displacement differences to preserve rigid-body behavior in single precision.
evidence_signal: On an RTX 3060, cantilever iterations took 0.46 s for 0.5 million elements and 15 s for 33.5 million; the displacement-difference formulation reduced compliance error from up to 5.4% to 1.3×10⁻⁵.
watch_item: Naively rounding element stiffness matrices to single precision introduces spurious rigid-body energy, so the displacement-difference formulation is essential to the reported accuracy.
paper_title: An open source Python code for three-dimensional topology optimization in single precision on a consumer GPU
